newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rareco in Malawi venture with Caledonia.
newsitem.headline: Rareco in Malawi venture with Caledonia.

text.p: South African rare earth mining and extraction company Rareco Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed a joint venture agreement with Caledonia Mining Corp to develop a Malawi rare earth project.
It said the agreement would see the development of the Kangankunde cabonatite pipe -- which contains large reserves of moazite and strontiate.
Rareco said it will hold 50 percent of the deposit and have the exclusive right to purchase all of the mineral production from the operation.
It said the Malawi venture and another agreement signed with UK-based Meldform Metals Ltd will position the company to develop new market opportunities.
Rareco said it signed an exclusive marketing, sales and distribution agreement with Meldform which is recognised as a leading supplier of rare earth metals and chemicals.
The company said Medlform has undertaken to sell Rareco's entire production of rare earth chloride from the Steenkampskraal mine, near Vanrhynsdorp.
"The two international agreements, signed within a weeek of each other, are a realisation of our intent to revitalise Rareco's operations and restore investor confidence," the company said.
